format: walk.json v1. Coordinates are integers in 1e-5 degree units, (lon, lat) order. nodes: flat [x0,y0,x1,y1,...], delta-encoded (node i = running sum of pairs 0..i; pair 0 is absolute); Hilbert order. edges: flat, stride 6, one record per undirected edge, sorted by a then b: [da, db, m, name, flags, ns]; a = previous record a + da (first: a = da), b = a + db (b >= a), m = walking length in whole metres along the full geometry, name = index into names, flags = 1 car-free path (park path/greenway/promenade/park drive/bridge walkway) | 2 bridge or footbridge | 4 steps, ns = number of interior shape points. shape: flat [dx,dy,...] interior shape points of every edge in edge-record order (edge k starts at pair sum of ns before k); each point is a delta from the previous point, the first from node a; polyline = a -> shape -> b. names: names[0] is always "path" (unnamed car-free path) and names[1] "steps" (unnamed stairs), the rest most used first; "" is an unnamed street. Snapping a point: prefer the nearest edge without flag 2; take a bridge edge only when it is within 40 m and no other edge is within max(40 m, its distance + 25 m), or within 10 m with no other edge within its distance + 15 m.
